Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 16:02:00 +0000
Subject: Next steps: ML Lab - 75min ops + model-serving runthrough

Hi Sam / Elaine —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side: Synaptic is prioritizing lower-latency model serving for customer-facing features and needs a repeatable deployment pattern (VPC + key management) plus guidance on batching/kv-cache strategies. You also mentioned wanting to validate cost estimates for steady-state traffic and a plan for a 0->1 pilot.

Proposed next step: a 60–90 minute ML Lab (ops + model-serving runthrough) with our infra and ML engineering team. Goals for the session:
- Walk through your current serving topology and constraints (network, regions, security)
- Run the end-to-end demo: model load, inference latency profile, and KV/prefix caching behavior
- Discuss batching/quantization tradeoffs and rough cost estimates for your traffic profile
- Define a short mutual action plan and owners for the pilot

Suggested windows (PST / local equivalents):
- Wed 2028-01-18 09:00–10:15 PST (75m)
- Thu 2028-01-19 11:00–12:30 PST (90m)
- Mon 2028-01-23 08:30–09:45 PST (75m)

Attendees we propose from Redwood: Grace (me, AE) + Marcus Lin (Solutions Eng) + Ben Carter (Infra lead). Please confirm which of the windows works for you and whether we should include any additional Synaptic engineers (Jordan was mentioned).

I've attached a short agenda and prep checklist; we'll add a calendar invite once a time is confirmed.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Grace

Grace — thanks for the clear recap. Wed/Thu mornings sound best for us. Quick notes:
- We want the session focused on production constraints (VPC peering, egress controls, KMS) and a realistic demo of throughput at ~200 QPS with 512-token context.
- Jordan (our infra engineer) will join and can share a short topology diagram if you want ahead of the call.

I can do Thu 2028-01-19 at 11:00 PST (the 90m slot). If that works, please send the invite; otherwise Wed morning is OK.

Also please drop the agenda and any quick preread so Elaine and Jordan can prep.
